answer: Farming becomes an orchard bet on surviving 81 epochs of grading, and every ocean settlement recomputes the echo schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 81 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
